auxiliary_lemmas.statement_sketch: DENSITY/RADON-NIKODYM FORM (round 7). Fix the face `A` (the finite, nonempty action type), a finite rational parameter grid `g : S -> R^d` (`d = |A| - 1`, `S` a `Fintype`) on the quotient ball with rational prior weights `w : FiniteDesign S`, a positive-definite rational `Omega` from the certified covariance cell, and the simple-regret loss `l : A -> S -> R`, `l a s = max_{k in A} (J_A (g s))_k - (J_A (g s))_a`, nonnegative and bounded by `L_M` on the ball by (49). The observation is `Y ~ N(g s, Omega)` on `R^d` — a CONTINUUM, so the posterior is defined by densities, not by singleton masses. Write `f s y = phi_Omega (y - g s)` for the Gaussian density (obtained by whitening: `phi_Omega (u) = |det Omega|^(-1/2) prod_i gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((Omega^(-1/2) u)_i)`, so that `mu_s = Lebesgue.withDensity (f s)` is `N(g s, Omega)` by `ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal_of_var_ne_zero` coordinatewise and `rnDeriv_gaussianReal` gives the Radon-Nikodym identification), and `m y = sum_s w.p s * f s y` for the mixture density. Four conjuncts. (a) POSITIVE MIXTURE DENSITY AND GUARDED POSTERIOR DESIGN: `f s y > 0` for every `y` by `ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDF_pos` composed with the whitening bijection, hence `m y > 0` everywhere (the prior weights being nonnegative and summing to one), so the posterior weights `pi s y = w.p s * f s y / m y` are well defined, nonnegative and sum to one, and assemble into a `Causalean.Experimentation.DesignBased.FiniteDesign S` for every `y`; the definition nevertheless carries the guarded branch `if m y = 0 then (uniform design on S) else ...`, an ARBITRARY posterior design on the (provably empty here, but syntactically present) null fibre, so that no positivity side condition propagates into the consumers. (b) UNNORMALIZED POSTERIOR COST: with `c a y = sum_s pi s y * l a s`, the identity `m y * c a y = sum_s w.p s * f s y * l a s` holds pointwise — the unnormalized cost of (50) — by clearing the common denominator on the positive branch and by both sides vanishing on the guarded branch. (c) FINITE-ACTION MINIMIZER: for each `y` the pointwise minimum `min_a c a y` is ATTAINED (finite nonempty `A`, so the `iInf` is a `Finset.inf'`) and equals `Causalean.Stat.finiteDesignBayesRisk (posterior design at y) l`; it is measurable in `y` as a finite lattice-minimum of the measurable `c a` (`Measurable.inf` iterated over `A`, each `c a` measurable because `f s` is continuous), and directed-interval enclosures of the finitely many `c a y` bracket it. (d) BAYES VALUE BY TONELLI: `integral_{R^d} (m y * min_a c a y) dy` — the value `V(w,Omega)` of (51) — equals the Bayes risk of the finite prior `w` in the Gaussian experiment, i.e. `iInf over measurable randomized selectors of sum_s w.p s * integral l (delta y) s dmu_s`; the interchange of the finite `sum_s` with the integral is `MeasureTheory.lintegral_finset_sum` / `MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum` (each summand integrable: `l` bounded on the ball, `f s` a probability density) and the passage between `dmu_s` and `f s y dy` is `integral_withDensity_eq_integral_smul`. THE ACTION TYPE IS THE SELECTOR SUBTYPE. Let `Sel = {delta : R^d -> Delta_A // Measurable delta}` be the subtype of measurable randomized quotient selectors — the very type at which S5 spells `G_{A,M} = Causalean.Stat.minimaxValue selRisk` with `selRisk delta u = integral over Y ~ N(u, Omega) of the simple-regret loss of delta` on the model class `K_M` — and note `Sel` is nonempty (any constant selector). Three conjuncts. (a) FINITE-GRID SELECTOR LOSS AND ITS BAYES VALUE. Define `gridLoss : Sel -> S -> R` by `gridLoss delta s = integral_{R^d} (sum_{a in A} delta(y)_a * l a s) dmu_{g s}(y)`, i.e. the Gaussian risk of the selector at the grid point `g s`; it is nonnegative (by (49), `l >= 0` and `delta(y) in Delta_A`) and bounded by `L_M`. Then `Causalean.Stat.finiteDesignBayesRisk w gridLoss = iInf_{delta in Sel} sum_s w.p s * gridLoss delta s`, and THIS quantity equals the density-posterior/Tonelli integral `V(w,Omega) = integral (m y * min_a c a y) dy` of `lem:finite-action-posterior-cost` conjunct (d): >= is the pointwise bound `sum_a delta(y)_a c a y >= min_a c a y` integrated against `m y dy` after the Fubini interchange, and <= is realized by the (measurable, by conjunct (c) of that lemma) argmin selector, which lies in `Sel`. This is the ONLY place the two layers meet; the inner `finiteDesignBayesRisk` of `lem:finite-action-posterior-cost` — action type `A`, evaluated at a fixed `y` — appears here only inside the integrand `min_a c a y`.
